publication.title: A new saurolophine hadrosaurid (Dinosauria: Ornithopoda) from the Upper Cretaceous of South China, providing further support for the possible Asian origin of Brachylophosaurini
authors: J. Yu, L. Yang, H. Wang, S. Cao, K. Zhao, M. Xu, G. Shi, F. Lou, C. Zeng, P. Lu, R. Wu, X. Xu, F. Han, H. Xing

locality.name: PBDB collection 278619: The bonebed elements ascribed to Gongshuilong were collected from a quarry during the construction of the East China International Trade and Industrial Zone. The quarry is located at the Zhutongkeng locality, Shahe Town, Zhanggong District, Ganzhou City, Jiangxi Province, and is 2 km south-east of the railway station.

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 278619 to Maastrichtian with numeric bounds 72.2–66 Ma.
